contea di ritrovamento: Nottinghamshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ IMP C CONSTANTINVS PF AVG ; R/ SOL INVICTO COMITI In

Copper alloy Coin. Nummus. Constantine I (306-337). Reece period 15, issue of 310-319. Obverse description: Bust right. Obverse inscription: IMP C CONSTANTINVS PF AVG Reberse description: Sol standing left. Reverse inscription: SOL INVICTO COMITI In exergue: PLN, for London Mint. Diameter: 19.84mm, Weight: 2.33gms, die axis 6
